opening.argument: The presentation solicits participation in BitClub Network by tying a selected investment amount to daily passive bitcoin income. It describes buying a company share as a path to owning equipment that will extract Bitcoins for years, then promises that additional equipment will produce more income. The pitch reinforces those returns with claims of 3% to 5% monthly profitability and growing dollar figures, while attributing participant profit to investment-funded equipment, electricity, and Bitcoin purchases. The supplied material does not establish viewer losses or completed transactions, but those outcomes are not required to identify the promotional mechanism presented here.

citations.quote: now you only need to decide how much passive income you want to receive and select the appropriate amount of your participation in the Bit Club Network. After that, you will have a daily passive income in bitcoins.
Once you've bought a share of the company, you'll become the owner of the equipment, that will extract Bitcoins for many years.
For part of your profit Bit Club Network automatically buys new equipment to you. More equipment, more income.

Thanks to the large amount of investment the company buys equipment, electricity, and, much more effectively, buys Bitcoin, which significantly increases the profit of every BIT Club Network participant.
